# Test pe benchmark command functionality

env PE_TEST_MODE=true
env PE_MOCK_PROVIDER=true

# Test basic benchmark with config
pe benchmark bench-config.yaml
! stderr 'error'

# Test benchmark without config - should error
! pe benchmark
stderr .

# Test benchmark with nonexistent file - should error
! pe benchmark nonexistent.yaml
stderr .

# Test iterations flag - single run
pe benchmark repeat-config.yaml --iterations 1
! stderr 'error'

# Test iterations flag - multiple runs
pe benchmark repeat-config.yaml --iterations 5
! stderr 'error'

# Test iterations flag - many runs
pe benchmark repeat-config.yaml --iterations 10
! stderr 'error'

# Test concurrency flag - single thread
pe benchmark concurrent-config.yaml --concurrency 1
! stderr 'error'

# Test concurrency flag - multiple threads
pe benchmark concurrent-config.yaml --concurrency 3
! stderr 'error'

# Test concurrency flag - high concurrency
pe benchmark concurrent-config.yaml --concurrency 10
! stderr 'error'

# Test output formats - default (json)
pe benchmark format-config.yaml
! stderr 'error'

# Test output formats - json to file
pe benchmark format-config.yaml --output bench-results.json
! stderr 'error'
exists bench-results.json

# Test output formats - csv
pe benchmark format-config.yaml --format csv --output bench-results.csv
! stderr 'error'
exists bench-results.csv

# Test output formats - text
pe benchmark format-config.yaml --format text
! stderr 'error'

# Test go-bench format
pe benchmark format-config.yaml --go-bench
! stderr 'error'
stdout 'Benchmark'

# Test with multiple prompts
pe benchmark multi-bench.yaml --iterations 3
! stderr 'error'

# Test combined flags
pe benchmark bench-config.yaml --iterations 5 --concurrency 2
! stderr 'error'

pe benchmark bench-config.yaml --iterations 3 --format json
! stderr 'error'

-- bench-config.yaml --
description: "Benchmark test"
prompts:
  - "Test prompt"
providers:
  - "mock"
tests:
  - vars: {}
    assert:
      - type: contains
        value: "Mock"

-- repeat-config.yaml --
description: "Repeat test"
prompts:
  - "Test prompt"
providers:
  - "mock"
tests:
  - vars: {}
    assert:
      - type: contains
        value: "Mock"

-- concurrent-config.yaml --
description: "Concurrency test"
prompts:
  - "Test prompt"
providers:
  - "mock"
tests:
  - vars: {}
    assert:
      - type: contains
        value: "Mock"

-- format-config.yaml --
description: "Output format test"
prompts:
  - "Test prompt"
providers:
  - "mock"
tests:
  - vars: {}
    assert:
      - type: contains
        value: "Mock"

-- multi-bench.yaml --
description: "Multiple prompts benchmark"
prompts:
  - "Test prompt 1"
  - "Test prompt 2"
  - "Test prompt 3"
providers:
  - "mock"
tests:
  - vars: {}
    assert:
      - type: contains
        value: "Mock"
